clinical_sources.title: Fronto-insular circuit mechanisms of accelerated intermittent theta burst stimulation
Distinct antidepressant therapies act on a common brain network

locator.detail: Figure 2 and legend (PDF pp. 6–7); Results; Limitations (p. 15)

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Opsins reproduce a pulse pattern, not human magnetic stimulation. Rodent prelimbic cortex is not an exact human DLPFC homologue. Cellular plasticity and antidepressant-like behavior do not establish a clinical treatment mechanism or drug recommendation.

locator.detail: Figure 5A–F and Results on PDF p. 11

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Necessity and sufficiency concern these mouse manipulations and behavioral assays, not remission of human depression. FST inhibition groups had n=20/19/22; NIH groups n=12/14/13; projection-specific groups n=10/11. No human fronto-insular tract is reconstructed.

locator.detail: Figure 6A–E; legend continues on PDF p. 14; STAR Methods, TMS–iEEG

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Ten patients contributed, with 8–10 per region; five overlapped an earlier report. These 0.5-Hz pulses probed connectivity and were not an antidepressant aiTBS trial. Responses do not prove a direct monosynaptic tract or a mood mechanism.

locator.detail: Figure 6F–J and legend on PDF p. 14; STAR Methods, Human participants and fMRI Data Analysis (p. 31)

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Exploratory same-cohort correlations, without sham control or external predictive validation. This is not a randomized comparison of insula-based targeting and does not supersede BRIGhTMIND. The paper differs in anterior/posterior wording across text and figure labels, so no insular subregion is assigned here. Whole-brain feature screening is exploratory.

locator.detail: STAR Methods, fMRI Data Analysis; Figure S9D; Results on PDF p. 14

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: The same 51-person open-label cohort had no sham-treated arm. The uncorrected decrease must not be described as a confirmed treatment-induced change or as evidence that reducing this connection causes improvement.

locator.detail: Results, Longitudinal experiments and A common network; Figures 2–3 (PDF p. 3); Methods pp. 8–9

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Discovery comprised 11 ECT, 4 pharmacotherapy and 1 MST experiments, not DBS or rTMS. Seeds reflected gray-matter increases, usually not demonstrated correlations with symptom improvement. Coordinate spheres and a healthy 652-person connectome introduce spatial and population assumptions. Whole amygdala surfaces are broader than the derived hub clusters.

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Validation concerns spatial resemblance of networks constructed from structural changes. It does not establish clinical prediction, mediation or superiority of DTN-guided stimulation. The 94 ECT participants are separate from the discovery synthesis; the comparison cohort contained 21 Parkinson’s patients.

locator.detail: Figure 5 and caption; Results on PDF p. 4; Methods p. 9

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: Ten rats per arm were assigned; one per arm was excluded for cannula placement, leaving nine per arm. This supports a causal contribution in a rat ECS model, not efficacy of human amygdala DBS or TMS. Behavioral assays and drug inactivation do not identify a human stimulation target.

locator.detail: Figure 7a; Generalizability on PDF p. 5; Methods p. 9

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: These are selected literature sites, not 24 new patients or a randomized target comparison. Positive and negative functional connectivity do not mean excitation and inhibition. DBS/rTMS were absent from the network’s discovery experiments; exact site coordinates and electric fields are not reconstructed here.

locator.detail: Figure 7b (called 7c in the Results text); Generalizability on PDF pp. 5 and 10

finding_checks.status: Full text, relevant figures and methods checked
finding_checks.limitations: This is a change–change association in a previously collected dataset, not baseline prediction or a prospective DTN-guided efficacy trial. Several covariates were controlled; causality and clinical utility remain unestablished. Other symptom associations were nonsignificant, which does not establish perfect depression specificity. No DLPFC coil site is inferred for this dataset.

spatial_review.johnson: No reusable study-specific imaging volume or electrodes identified in the data statement. No human registration of mouse PL/insula experiments.
spatial_review.ji: Author DTN.nii linked externally. Repository lists DTN.nii and README only, without a separate data reuse license; article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. No derived volume is redistributed. Reference anatomy does not delineate the hub clusters.
